title: The Crooked Circle
subtitle: A Mysterious Illness and a Deadly Secret
summary: When a desperate doctor begs for Byomkesh Bakshi’s help with a gravely ill patient, the renowned detective’s curiosity is piqued by the strange request and the shadows lurking behind it. What begins as a medical mystery soon hints at something far more sinister. Step into a world of intrigue where every answer only leads to more questions.
